what: Two-page boards (schedule, comparison table) float at 1.05x, folded 50° on each side around the center spine. When they enter above the bottom 20% of the screen, they unfold over 1 second and lie flat in place (1x) — the dark shade (ink 15%) on each page’s spine side clears in .8s, the board appears in .3s, and the text inside the page rises .4s later over .8s (once).

options.start: Where expansion starts (ScrollTrigger start), default top 80%
options.--fx-angle: Fold angle (via style), default 50deg — at 0deg no fold, only shade and text (when stacking in one line on phones)
options.[data-fx-part=page]: Two pages (exactly two). The front page folds on its right edge, the back page on its left edge
options.[data-fx-part=content]: (optional) text group that floats up .4s late within the page

use:
Left side
Right side
note: The original applied a drop-shadow to the whole panel (0 1px 40px → 1px, navy 20%), but this part applies the skin shadow (--kf-shadow-lift → --kf-shadow-soft) to each side separately
